settings.heading: Made for the miles ahead.
settings.text: From frozen trailheads to the drive home, this piece holds its own. We build every piece to be worn hard, repaired, and handed down — because the gear you trust should last as long as the memories you make in it.

settings.title: 4-Way Stretch Fabric
settings.description: Our proprietary blend moves with you in every direction — no binding, no pulling, no excuses.

settings.title: Reinforced Stress Points
settings.description: Triple-stitched seams and bartacks at every stress point mean this piece outlasts the season.

settings.title: DWR Weather Repellent
settings.description: Durable Water Repellent finish sheds light rain and holds off wind chill on the fly.

settings.title: YKK Hardware
settings.description: Every zipper, buckle, and snap is YKK — because the details matter on the trail and off it.

settings.question: What is your return policy?
settings.answer: We offer free 30-day returns on all orders. Items must be unworn and in original condition. Start a return from your account page or email us at support@honorinclothing.com.

settings.question: How do I care for this product?
settings.answer: Machine wash cold on gentle cycle. Tumble dry low or hang dry. Do not bleach or iron directly on logos. Proper care extends the life of every piece.

settings.question: When will my order ship?
settings.answer: Orders ship within 1–2 business days. You'll receive tracking info by email as soon as your order leaves our facility. Free shipping on orders over $75.

settings.question: I'm between sizes — what should I do?
settings.answer: We recommend sizing up for a relaxed, layering fit or staying true to size for a more tailored look. Check the size guide for exact measurements.
